priority_note: Pilot map favors standards that produce the most teachable FAST-style leverage. Adjust after released-test tagging and class data review.

standards.notes: Key literary elements and layers of meaning/style.
Theme development is high-yield and requires repeated evidence work.
Perspective, irony, and satire need explicit scaffolding.
Epic poetry needs targeted convention lessons, not overbuilt volume.
Text structure often requires longer paragraph windows.
Central idea and support is a core FAST lift.
Opposing arguments need paired excerpts and DBQ-style scaffolds.
Paraphrase is embedded in every lesson routine.
Adaptations and source comparison need explicit cross-text practice.
Academic vocabulary is embedded in every deck.
